notes: text: 4次試験終了から3日後 — three days after the 4th exam ended
text: ここは委員会が経営するホテルじゃが — this is a hotel run by the Committee

english: everyone, gentlemen (address to a group; slightly formal/dated)
notes: text: さて諸君ゆっくり休めたかな? — now then everyone, did you get to rest well?
text: 決勝が終了するまで — until the finals are over
text: 君達の貸し切りとなっておる — it's been made reserved just for you all
text: 最終試験は1対1のトーナメント形式で行う — the final exam will be held in a 1-on-1 tournament format
text: その組み合わせは… — that matchup is...
text: 最終試験のクリア条件はいたって明確だが — the clearance condition for the final exam is quite clear, but
text: いたって明確だが — it's quite clear, but
text: たった1勝で合格である!! — passing requires just a single win!!

english: to drop out, to withdraw, to pass out of (a bracket)
notes: text: 勝った者が次々ぬけていき — those who win drop out one after another
Uncommon kanji for まける — usually written 負ける. Text: 敗けた者が上に登っていくシステム — a system where those who lose climb upward
text: この表の頂点は不合格を意味するわけだ — the top of this chart means failure
text: 不合格を意味するわけだ — it means failure
text: 組み合わせが公平でない理由は? — what's the reason the matchups aren't fair?
text: うむ当然の疑問じゃな — indeed, a natural question

english: match, bout, pairing (sumo-derived term, also used generally for tackling a task)
notes: text: この取り組みは今まで行われた試験の成績をもとに決められている — this matchup is decided based on past exam results
text: 試験の成績をもとに決められている — decided based on exam performance

english: to give, to grant, to award
notes: text: チャンスが多く与えられているということ — meaning more chances are given
text: それって納得できないな — I can't accept/be convinced by that

english: the way something is assigned or determined
notes: text: 点数のつけ方とか教えてよ — teach me how the points are assigned
text: 採点内容は極秘事項で全てを言うわけにはいかない — the grading content is confidential, so I can't tell you everything
text: 極秘事項でな — it's a confidential matter
text: まず審査基準 — first, the judging criteria

english: the body, physical (as opposed to mental)
notes: text: 身体能力値・精神能力値・そして印象値 — physical ability score, mental ability score, and impression score
text: 身体能力値・精神能力値 — physical ability score, mental ability score
text: 精神能力値 — mental ability score
text: 重要なのは印象値! — what matters is the "impression score"! (印象値 is this exam's coined term for it)

english: just for reference, only a rough guideline
notes: text: これはあくまで参考程度 — this is only a rough reference
text: …等の総合値を示す — indicates the overall/composite value of...

english: to raise, to cite, to list (an example or value)
notes: text: 前に挙げた値では計られない — cannot be measured by the values cited earlier
text: 前に挙げた値では計られない — cannot be measured by the values cited before
text: いうなればハンターの資質評価といったところか — you could call it an assessment of one's aptitude as a Hunter
text: 諸君らの生の声とを吟味した結果こうなった — this is the result of examining your own firsthand opinions
text: 諸君らの生の声とを吟味した結果こうなった — this is the result of carefully examining your firsthand opinions
Four-character idiom. Text: 戦い方も単純明快 — the way of fighting is also simple and clear
text: 武器OK・反則なし — weapons OK, no fouls
text: 武器OK・反則なし — weapons OK, no fouls

english: I give up, I concede (from the verb 参る)
notes: text: 相手にまいったと言わせれば勝ち! — if you make your opponent say 'I give up,' you win!

english: to be inferior to, to fall short of
notes: text: 資質でオレがゴンに劣っている!? — I'm inferior to Gon in aptitude!?

english: to cause (someone's) death, to bring about someone's death
notes: text: 相手を死にいたらしめてしまった者は即失格! — anyone who causes their opponent's death is disqualified on the spot!
text: 即失格! — immediate disqualification!
text: その時点で残りの者が合格じゃ — at that point, the remaining participants pass
text: 第1試合 — Match 1

english: to tail, to shadow, to follow secretly
notes: Uncommon kanji for this reading — more often written 尾行する. Text: 4次試験の間ずっとオレを尾けてたろ — you were tailing me the whole 4th exam, weren't you
text: 私、立会人をつとめさせていただきますマスタです — I'm Masuta, serving as the official witness
text: 受験生一人一人に試験官が尾いてたんだろ? — an examiner was tailing each and every examinee, right?
text: 受験生一人一人に試験官が尾いてたんだろ? — an examiner was tailing each examinee

english: the others, that bunch, those guys (casual/dismissive)
notes: text: まあ他の連中も気づいてたとは思うがな — well, I figure the others noticed too

english: to dare to, to go out of one's way to (do something)
notes: text: あえて言うこともないと思ってたんだが — I didn't think it was worth bringing up
text: アンタの審査が正確だったからだ! — because your judging was accurate!

english: entertainment, a sideshow, an extra amusement
notes: text: ま余興のことだが — well, regarding that little sideshow
text: 気絶させてもカウントはとらないしTKOもなし — even if you knock someone out, there's no count and no TKO
text: こいつはちっと厄介かもな — this one might be a bit of a handful
text: 体力とスピードなら…オレだって負けないぞ — when it comes to stamina and speed, I won't lose either

english: a chance to win, a winning opportunity
notes: text: 速さでかきまわして勝機をみつける! — stir things up with speed and find a chance to win!

english: to acknowledge, to admit, to recognize
notes: text: 認めるぜ — I'll admit it
text: おおかた足に自信アリってとこか — I'd guess you're confident in your legs

english: well done, a good job, well made
notes: text: 子供にしちゃ上出来だ — not bad for a kid
text: オレなら軽くよけれるぜあの程度… — I could dodge something at that level easily

english: to wake up, to come to (regain consciousness)
notes: text: ほれ目ェ覚ましな — hey, wake up now
text: 普通の決闘なら勝負アリなんだが — in a normal duel this would already be settled

english: the match is over, the bout is decided (referee's call ending a contest)
notes: text: 普通の決闘なら勝負アリなんだが — in a normal duel this would already be settled
text: 脳みそがグルングルンゆれるように打ったからな — because I hit you so your brain would rattle around
text: 早いとこギブアップしちまいな — just give up already, quickly
text: わかったろ差は歴然だ — you get it now, right? the difference is obvious

english: to be stubborn, to dig in one's heels
notes: text: 意地はっていいことなんか一つもないぜ — being stubborn won't do you any good at all
text: 今なら次の試合に影響は少ない — if it's now, the impact on the next match will be small
text: さっさと言っちまいな — just say it already

english: acting high and mighty, putting on airs
notes: text: あんな状態でえらそーにしゃがって — acting so high and mighty in that state (text elongates it as えらそーに)

english: it can't be helped, there's no other way
notes: text: わかってるがしゃーねーだろ!! — I know, but there's no helping it!! (しゃーねー is a slangy contraction of しょうがない)

english: position, standpoint, the situation one is in
notes: text: お前がゴンの立場ならまいったと言えるか? — if you were in Gon's position, could you say 'I give up'?
text: 矛盾だらけだが気持ちはよくわかる — it's full of contradictions, but I understand the feeling well

english: to stop, to quit, to refrain from (doing something)
notes: text: 無理はよせ!!次があるんだぞここは… — don't push yourself!! there's a next match, this isn't it...

english: to retreat, to withdraw, to back down
notes: text: ここは退けゴン!! — back down here, Gon!!

english: to self-destruct, to bring about one's own ruin
notes: text: 自滅するぞ!! — you'll destroy yourself!!
text: 一風変わったところかどんでもない決闘システムだわ — it's an unusual, or rather outrageous dueling system
text: どんでもない決闘システムだわ — an outrageous dueling system
text: 気軽に「まいった」なんて言える奴がここまで残れるわけないじゃない — someone who could casually say 'I give up' wouldn't have made it this far

english: to be no match for, in a different league entirely
notes: text: 私達の比じゃないわよ — it's no comparison to us, i.e. far worse (casual じゃない for ではない)
text: もう血へども出なくなってるぞ — you're not even coughing up blood anymore (text writes it as 血へど, mixing kanji and hiragana)

english: knock it off, that's enough (idiom of exasperation)
notes: text: いい加減にしゃがれてめぇ — knock it off already, you

english: to kill (someone) dead, to beat the hell out of (crude/violent slang)
notes: text: ぶっ殺すぞ!! — I'll kill you!!

english: unbearable to watch, too pitiful to look at
notes: text: 見るに耐えないなら消えろよ — if you can't bear to watch, then get lost
text: 仮にこの状況であなたが手を出せば — hypothetically, if you were to intervene in this situation

english: to intervene, to get involved, to lay a hand on
notes: text: あなたが手を出せば失格になるのはゴン選手ですよ — if you intervene, it's Gon who will be disqualified

english: another person, a third party, an outsider
notes: text: 1対1の勝負に他者は入れません — a third party cannot enter a one-on-one match
text: 全然平気さまだまだやれる — I'm totally fine, I can still keep going
text: 腕を折る — (I'll) break his arm
text: 本気だぜ — I'm serious
